keyPoints: Rasayanik abhikriya me ek ya zyada padarth (abhikarak) badalkar naye gun wale padarth (utpad) banate hain — jaise lohe par jang lagna.
Rasayanik samikaran abhikriya ka sankshipt roop hai; santulit samikaran me dono taraf har tatva ke parmanu barabar hote hain kyunki bhaar ka sanrakshan hota hai.
Sanyog abhikriya me do padarth milkar ek bante hain (magnesium ka jalna), viyojan me ek padarth tootkar do ya zyada banta hai (choone ka garm hona).
Visthapan abhikriya me zyada kriyashil tatva kam kriyashil ko uske yogik se hata deta hai — loha taambe ko neele thothe ke vilayan se nikaal deta hai.
Upchayan me oxygen ka mel ya electron ka tyag hota hai, apchayan me oxygen ka nikalna ya electron ka grahan; dono hamesha saath-saath hote hain.
Jang lagna aur makkhan ka kharab hona (rancidity) dheemi upchayan abhikriyaon ke udaharan hain; chips ke packet me nitrogen bhari jaati hai taaki upchayan ruke.
Aam galti: sanket (→) ke dono taraf parmanu gine bina samikaran ko santulit manna; pehle hit-and-trial se santulan karo, phir aage badho.
